description: Run the available platform setup checks before driving the app: exact runtime connected, automation driver reachable, app installed, required env vars present, plus connectivity checks available for that platform. Returns a structured result — when ok: false, follow each finding's remediation and DO NOT attempt to fix environment issues by editing source code. To bring everything up in one call (Metro + build + verify), use ceraph_start.

bundleId.description: Usually omit — Ceraph detects the project's iOS bundle ID or Android package ID. Pass an intentional build-variant override.

device.description: Exact runtime id or adb serial.

expectedNetwork.description: Optional WiFi SSID the user expects the laptop (and phone) to be on. Mismatch is a warning, not an error.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

requiredEnv.description: Env var names the app under test requires. Each must be set + non-empty.

variant.description: Android only: exact debuggable Gradle application variant, such as developmentDebug.

name: ceraph_doctor
